description:
The migration manifest lists sources of epic 6dc81018 as pending at their `dev/active/` and `dev/benchmarks/` paths. Container archival moved them under `dev/archive/6dc81018-field-capability-dispatch/`, so the progress checker reports each row's pending source as missing.

## Background

The manifest is `dev/active/fa787f85-documentation-overhaul/migration/manifest.toml`; its checker is `migration/check.py`. The archive event's planned moves are recorded in the tracker event log.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each manifest row whose source the 6dc81018 archive moved records its archive destination and a complete status, taken from the archive's recorded moves by a committed command, not by hand.
- [hard] REQ-02: The progress checker exits zero on the repository, and its self-tests pass.
- [hard] REQ-03: Rows of sources that the archive copied and left in place keep their source path and status.
title: Reconcile the migration manifest with the archived field-dispatch epic
